referrals.faqHowWorks: How does the recomendación program work?
referrals.faqHowWorks1: Yabelana ngesixhumanisi sakho esiyingqayizivele sokudlulisela nabangani nomndeni.
referrals.faqHowWorks2: Uma othile ebhalisa esebenzisa isixhumanisi sakho futhi eqeda ukubhuka kwakhe kokuqala okufanelekile, uzuza ikhredithi yesikhwama kanye namaphoyinti okwethembeka.

referrals.faqHowMuch: How much can I earn from recomendacións?
referrals.faqHowMuchAnswer: Uzuza {{amount}} {{currency}} ngokuthunyelwa ngakunye okuyimpumelelo. Inani lingahluka ngokuya ngezinyuso zamanje. Hlola ideshibhodi yakho yokudlulisela amanani akamuva omklomelo.
referrals.faqWhenRewards: When do I receive my recomendación recompensas?
referrals.faqWhenRewardsAnswer: Uthola umklomelo wakho wokuthumela ngemva kokuba umuntu omthumele eqede ukubhukha kwakhe kokuqala ku-Beautonomi. Umklomelo ufakwa esikhwameni sakho futhi ungasetshenziselwa ukubhukha esikhathini esizayo noma ukhishwe ngokuvumelana nenqubomgomo yethu yokukhokha.
referrals.faqSamePerson: Ngingakwazi ukubhekisela kumuntu ofanayo izikhathi eziningi?
referrals.faqSamePersonAnswer: Cha, umuntu ngamunye angathunyelwa kanye kuphela. Uma umuntu esebhalisele Beautonomi, akakwazi ukusebenzisa isixhumanisi sakho sokudlulisela ukuzuza imiklomelo.
referrals.faqTrack: How do I track my recomendacións?
referrals.faqTrackAnswer: Ungakwazi ukulandelela konke ukudluliselwa kwakho, izinzuzo, kanye nemiklomelo elindile kuleli khasi. Ideshibhodi ibonisa isamba sokudluliselwa kwakho, ukudluliselwa okuphumelelayo, kanye nesamba semali oyitholayo.
